# 🧠 Architecture Decision Record

## Metadata
- ADR number:
- Title:
- Status: proposed / accepted / superseded / deprecated
- Date:
- Decision owner:

## Context and constraints
Describe the problem and relevant project limitations.

## Decision
State the selected approach and scope.

## Alternatives
List realistic alternatives and why they were rejected.

## Consequences
Positive, negative and operational effects.

## Security, privacy and algorithm correctness
Describe data boundaries, threat impact and mathematical assumptions.

## Rollout and reversibility
Migration, compatibility, rollback and follow-up work.

## References
Issues, pull requests and supporting sources.
